# Boy Scout Trail

> Comprehensive resource for Boy Scouts, Cub Scouts, and Scouts BSA programs with advancement guides, activities, ceremonies, and campfire content.

Boy Scout Trail provides practical resources for scout leaders and participants across all age levels, from Cub Scouts through Eagle Scout. The site covers rank advancement, merit badges, program activities, and ceremonial content to support troop and pack operations.

## Key Topics

- Scouts BSA
- Cub Scouts
- Eagle Scout
- Merit Badges
- Rank Advancement
- Scout Activities
- Boy Scouts of America
- Webelos
- Arrow of Light
- Scout Ceremonies
- Group Games
- Campfire Programs
- Uniform Requirements
- Service Projects
- Youth Scouting

## Core Programs

- [Scouts BSA, Boy Scouts 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/boy-scouts/boy-scouts.asp): Scouts BSA program information for troops and advancement
- [2026 Cub Scouts Help, Ideas, Age, and Aids 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/24cub-scouts/cub-scouts.php): Cub Scouts program resources for ranks and pack/den ideas

## Advancement & Recognition

- [Boy Scout Advancements 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/advancements.asp): Scout rank advancement requirements and merit badge guide
- [Merit Badges 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/boy-scouts/merit-badges.asp): Merit badge requirements worksheets for Scouts BSA
- [Scout Awards - Eagle, Religious, and More 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/awards.asp): Scout awards including Eagle Scout and recognition programs
- [Boy Scout Uniforms and Cub Scout Uniforms 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/uniforms.asp): Scout uniform guidelines and badge placement requirements

## Ceremonies & Programs

- [Scout Ceremonies - Eagle, Flag, Court of Honor 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/ceremonies.asp): Scout ceremonies for advancement, Eagle, and court of honor
- [Eagle Scout Projects and More 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/projects.asp): Eagle Scout and service project ideas for scouts
- [Scoutmaster Minutes 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/minutes.asp): Scoutmaster minutes with inspirational stories for meetings

## Activities & Games

- [Group Activity - Outdoor games for youth groups 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/activities.asp): Group activities and outdoor games for scout programs
- [Group Games for Scouts and Youth Groups 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/games.asp): Group games collection for scouts indoors and outdoors
- [Campfire Songs for Scouts 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/songs.asp): Campfire songs collection for scout activities
- [Skits - scouts comedy ideas 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/skits.asp): Comedy skits and campfire program ideas for scouts
- [Short Stories of the Year - ghosts, humor, fun 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/stories.asp): Campfire stories including ghost and humorous tales

## Camping & Outdoor Resources

- [Easy Food Recipes - dutch oven cooking for kids 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/recipes.asp): Scout camping recipes including dutch oven cooking
- [Before Meal Graces for Scouts 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/graces.asp): Before-meal blessings and graces for scout camping

## Community & Connection

- [Scout Pen Pals 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/penpals): Scout pen pal matching service for community connection
- [Scout Postcard Exchange 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/postcards): Scout postcard exchange program for group participation
- [Scoutmaster Musings scouting 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/scoutmastermusings.asp): Scoutmaster column on scouting history and Norman Rockwell

## Optional

- [Clean Jokes for Scouts and Kids 2026](https://www.boyscouttrail.com/jokes.asp): Clean jokes collection for scouts and youth groups
